title: Design HashMap
summary: Store integer keys and values without a built-in hash map.
statement: Store integer keys and values without a built-in hash map. A put replaces any value already stored under that key. A get on an absent key returns −1. Removing an absent key has no effect.

examples.explanation: Stored zero differs from an absent mapping.
The second put replaces the first.

constraints: At most 10000 calls. Keys and values are in [0,1000000]. Rows are [0,key,value] for put, [1,key] for remove, and [2,key] for get.
hints: Conceptual: Each key has one current mapping.
Directional: The bounded key range can index an array directly.
Implementation: Use a presence flag or encode stored values so that the initial slot is distinguishable from value zero.
complexityAnalysis: O(U) initialization and space for U=1000001 direct-address slots. O(1) per call.
